plan.title: Continuously verify both supported Go toolchains and failure propagation

criteria.description: Main and PR CI matrix runs Go 1.23.12 and 1.27.3 with isolated newer analysis tools. Both actual remote matrix jobs must succeed; fault injection must show helper stops and propagates failures from vet, race tests, cross-vet and build.

limitations: Publish dedicated CI branch for validation and main integration only after verification. No settings changes or deliberately failing main commits. Actual push integration remains excluded.
